value.name: Lucia pulls back from the crease
value.description: Lucia's fingertips slide back from the crease, suggesting she has just been handling or examining something and is now releasing it.
evidence: Lucia's fingertips slid back from the crease as if released

value.name: Lucia checks the hall door
value.description: Lucia glances toward the closed hall door before turning her attention back to Asha, implying concern about being overheard.
evidence: her gaze went once to the closed hall door before it returned to Asha

value.name: Lucia reveals Daniel knows
value.description: Lucia quietly tells Asha that Daniel knows, revealing a significant piece of information.

value.name: Daniel eavesdrops at the door
value.description: On the other side of the door, Daniel presses his ear to the wood and listens for the meaning of Lucia and Asha's conversation.
evidence: On the other side of that door Daniel had set his ear close to the wood, breath held, trying to catch the shape of what was being said in the cadence of their voices

value.name: Daniel shifts and the floorboard creaks
value.description: Daniel's weight causes a faint floorboard creak, risking that the women inside may notice his presence.
evidence: the floorboard under his weight gave the smallest creak that none of them inside could be sure they had heard
